landing.title: Reports
landing.subtitle: Analyze sales, purchases, inventory, and finances — or export your data.

sales.title: Sales Report
sales.subtitle: Detailed analysis of sales performance

breakdown.title: Sales by category, brand and tag
breakdown.subtitle: See which groups sell the most and the least in this period.
breakdown.emptyDescription: Your categories, brands and tags are ranked here once something sells.
breakdown.noGroups: {dimension, select, category {None of your products have a category yet.} brand {None of your products have a brand yet.} other {None of your products have a tag yet.}}
breakdown.unassigned: {dimension, select, category {Products with no category} brand {Products with no brand} other {Products with no tag}}: {amount} from {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}.
breakdown.overlapNote: A product with more than one tag counts under each of its tags, so these figures add up to more than your total sales.
breakdown.basisNote: Item sales after returns. Order discounts and delivery charges are not split by item, so this can differ from Total Sales above.

sales.counterOnlyNote: Counter (POS) sales only. Online orders are counted in their own report.

cash.title: Cash Report
cash.subtitle: Cash flow and account balances overview
cash.accountsWithActivity: Accounts with movement in this period
cash.internalExcluded: Transfers and opening balances are left out: they move money between your own accounts, not in or out of the business.

employees.title: Staff Report
employees.subtitle: Activity and performance of your staff.

expiry.title: Expiry Report
expiry.subtitle: Batches that have expired or are expiring soon at this location

writeOff.title: Write off expired stock?
writeOff.body: This removes all {qty} units of {product} from batch {batch}. Expired stock cannot be sold, so it is already out of your sellable count — this clears it from your shelf figures too.
writeOff.note: Recorded as a stock movement with reason "expiry", so it stays in your stock history. This cannot be undone.
writeOff.failed: Could not write off this batch.
writeOff.noInventoryRow: This batch has no matching stock row — open Inventory → Adjust for this product instead.

inventory.title: Inventory Report
inventory.subtitle: Overview of your current inventory status

valuation.title: Stock Value
valuation.subtitle: What your current stock is worth, by product and category.
valuation.restrictedBody: Stock valuation is based on cost prices, which your role doesn't have permission to view. Ask an administrator for the cost visibility permission.

export.title: Export Data
export.subtitle: Download your data as CSV files
export.salesDataDesc: Export all sales records for the selected period
export.purchaseDataDesc: Export all purchase orders for the selected period
export.orderDataDesc: Export storefront orders with address, courier and payment

tax.title: VAT Report
tax.subtitle: Output VAT, input VAT, and net VAT payable for the period
tax.notEnabled: VAT is not enabled for this organization. Enable it in Settings → VAT to see this report.
tax.noTaxEvents: No VAT events in this period
tax.inputNotRecoverable: Not reclaimable with your registration — this VAT is part of your cost.
tax.explainerStandard: Net payable = Output VAT (sales − sales returns) − Input VAT (purchases − purchase returns). Positive means VAT is owed to the authority; negative is a reclaimable credit. Drafts and cancelled documents are excluded.
tax.explainerNoRebate: Net payable = Output VAT (sales − sales returns). Your registration type cannot reclaim input VAT, so VAT paid on purchases is shown for information only and is not deducted. Drafts and cancelled documents are excluded.

profitLoss.title: Profit & Loss
profitLoss.subtitle: Revenue minus cost of goods and operating expenses
profitLoss.unknownCostRevenue: Sales with no cost price (not counted in profit)
profitLoss.unknownCostNote: {amount} of revenue has no cost price, so it is left out of gross profit rather than counted as pure profit. Add cost prices to your products to see profit on these sales from now on.
profitLoss.expensesNotTracked: The Accounts module is off, so operating expenses are not being tracked. Net profit below equals gross profit — it does not mean you had no expenses.
profitLoss.basisNote: Revenue is recognised at the time of sale (including unpaid credit sales); expenses are recognised when paid. This is not an audited financial statement.
profitLoss.basisNoteOrders: Revenue is recognised when an order is dispatched (cash on delivery included, before the courier pays you); expenses are recognised when paid. This is not an audited financial statement.

position.title: Business Position
position.subtitle: What the business is worth right now — assets minus what you owe
position.cashNotTracked: The Accounts module is off, so cash and bank balances are not tracked. Cash shows as zero — it does not mean your drawer is empty.
position.basisNote: Stock is valued at cost, not at what you would sell it for. This is a snapshot of today, not a balance sheet — it has no owner's equity side and is not an audited financial statement.
position.stockNotTracked: This business does not track stock, so there is no stock value to include in assets.

orders.title: Orders Report
orders.subtitle: Storefront orders, counted on the day they were placed.
orders.counterNote: Counter (POS) sales are not on this page — they have their own report.
orders.avgBasis: Across orders that counted as revenue
orders.outstandingNote: On these orders, after advances and returns

profit.title: Gross profit
profit.marginBasis: Margin on revenue with a known cost
profit.unknownCost: {amount} of revenue has no cost behind it yet ({orders} orders not dispatched). The margin excludes it.

funnel.title: Where this period's orders got to
funnel.subtitle: Each stage counts orders that ever reached it, so the steps overlap. The chips below are where they are now and add up to the intake.
funnel.empty: No orders were placed in this period.

couriers.title: Couriers
couriers.subtitle: What each carried, what came back, and whether delivery paid for itself.

districts.title: Districts
districts.subtitle: Ranked by order volume. A single refused parcel is a 100% rate and not a finding.

sources.title: Order source
sources.subtitle: Where these orders came in from.

rejections.title: Why orders were rejected
rejections.subtitle: Orders the shop turned away. Cancellations are counted separately.
rejections.empty: No orders were rejected in this period.

topProducts.title: Top Selling Products
topProducts.empty: Nothing was ordered in this period.

breakdown.title: Orders by category, brand and tag
breakdown.subtitle: Which groups were ordered the most this period, and which the least.
breakdown.basisNote: Item sales after returns. Order discounts and delivery charges are not split by item, so this can differ from Net value above.
